passages.title: Order tracking and delivery updates
passages.text:
POL-SHIP-01 v1.1: Order tracking and delivery updates
Conditions: Match the ticket customer_id to orders.customer_id before using order details. Read shipment.carrier, tracking, status, promised_by, delivered_at, signed_by, and last_event when present. Use store.as_of as the current date. A null shipment or null last_event does not prove loss.
Rules: Share the recorded carrier, shipment status, latest available scan, and promised date. Describe promised_by as the recorded estimate, not a guaranteed arrival. If the order number is missing or several owned orders could match, ask which order the customer means and use awaiting_customer. General shipping questions do not require an order number. For a status-only request, a supported reply with an outbox receipt can resolve the ticket. Refer late, lost, and delivered-but-not-received cases to POL-SHIP-03. Do not claim to contact the carrier, change a shipment, or open a trace. None of those operations exists in the approved tool set.
Exceptions: An order belonging to another customer follows POL-SEC-02. An unknown ticket ID stops the run under the tool contract. Conflicting shipment facts require Delivery staff review; never fill a missing scan or date with an estimate.

passages.title: Manufacturing defects and warranty support
passages.text:
POL-WAR-01 v1.0: Manufacturing defects and warranty support
Conditions: The customer identifies an owned physical product and describes a defect. The agent has no verified manufacturer warranty terms or repair tool. A reported manufacturing defect may be assessed for warranty support whether discovered within or after the 30-day return window.
Rules: All physical products, including final-sale products, are eligible for store-facilitated warranty assessment of a manufacturing defect. This is eligibility for assessment, not a guarantee of manufacturer coverage. For defects after the standard return window, explain that an ordinary return is outside the window and route the warranty request to Human Review. Staff verifies the manufacturer terms and arranges any next step. Within the return window, damage or return policies may also apply. Do not invent a warranty duration, repair diagnosis, reimbursement amount, or manufacturer promise. The agent may explain the assessment path, but cannot submit a warranty claim, schedule a repair, or issue a replacement.
Exceptions: For a final-sale item, POL-RET-04 expressly denies this store-facilitated remedy. Preserve both passages and escalate the policy conflict. A change of mind alone is not a manufacturing defect. Out-of-window preference returns do not become warranty claims.

passages.title: Payment questions and invoice requests
passages.text:
POL-BIL-01 v1.1: Payment questions and invoice requests
Conditions: Match payments.order_id to an owned order. Use amount_cents, status, method, and captured_at to explain charges. Checkout accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover credit or debit cards.
Rules: Explain a verified charge using its date, amount, and related order. Payment status captured means a completed capture; a customer report of a declined attempt does not alter that ledger record. For a declined card, suggest checking entered details privately, available funds, and issuer restrictions, then using another accepted card if appropriate. Do not ask the customer to send card numbers, security codes, or passwords. No invoice document, invoice link, or invoice-creation tool exists. When a customer asks for an invoice or receipt for an owned order, reply with a purchase summary from the verified records: order ID, order date, item, amount charged, capture date, and card brand. After the message receipt, the ticket can be resolved. For missing order details, ask the customer. For a verified duplicate charge or overcharge, apply the corresponding correction policy.
Exceptions: Call the reply a purchase summary; never claim an official invoice or PDF was generated or attached. Ticket-quoted invoice numbers are unverified. A request for business details the store does not record, such as a company name or tax ID, goes to Billi…
